doc: stages/filters.dbscan.rst: 'labels each point with its associated cluster ID. Points that do not belong to a cluster are given a Cluster ID of -1. The remaining clusters are labeled as integers starting from 0.' The 10x10x10 unit lattice is one connected component at eps 1.5 (every interior point has 6 neighbours at distance 1, every corner 3 at 1 plus 3 at sqrt 2), so all 1000 points get ClusterID 0.
